sub_tasks.desc: Coder Agent: Implement User Registration Service with OWASP-compliant input validation. Use Spring Boot @RestController annotation. Validate email format (must contain single '@' and valid domain) and password strength (min 8 chars, uppercase, lowercase, digit, special char). Use prepared statements for all database operations to prevent SQL injection.

Coder Agent: Create database schema for users table. Implement exact DDL specification from global context. Include proper constraints (NOT NULL, UNIQUE, PRIMARY KEY). Add indexes for performance optimization.

Coder Agent: Implement User Authentication Service with JWT token generation. Implement JWT token generation with 15-minute expiry. Include refresh token mechanism with 7-day expiry. Implement password hashing using BCrypt with proper salt rounds.

Coder Agent: Create roles table schema and initial data. Implement roles table with predefined roles (System Admin, Center Admin, Manager, Teacher, Student). Include initial data insertion for all role types.

Coder Agent: Implement Center Service with CRUD operations. Implement all center management operations (create, read, update, delete). Enforce tax_id uniqueness constraint at service level. Implement proper input validation for all fields including email format and phone number validation.
Coder Agent: Create centers table schema. Implement centers table with all specified columns and constraints. Add proper indexes for performance on frequently queried fields.
